act.name: National Green Tribunal Act, 2010
act.source_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
act.description: Central law establishing the National Green Tribunal for environmental disputes, relief, compensation and restitution.

sections.title: Tribunal to settle disputes.
sections.text: Section 14 concerns the National Green Tribunal's jurisdiction over substantial environmental questions under scheduled enactments; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: The NGT decides qualifying civil disputes involving substantial environmental questions arising under scheduled laws.
